title: Repair the Wallet
prompt: Use integer cents. Accept only positive integer deposits and withdrawals (booleans are invalid). Reject overdrafts without changing balance or history. Return a copy of the transaction history.

functions.name: withdraw
functions.purpose: Withdraw only available positive integer cents.

todos.instructions: Return a copy of the transaction history.

tests.name: Deposits update balance and history
tests.safe_failure_message: Deposits update balance and history failed.

sabotage_objectives.private_description: After withdraw-bounds passes, introduce a subtle logic error only inside withdraw. Keep the verified revision unchanged until the round deadline.
sabotage_objectives.fairness_notes: Server checks author history, target-only syntax changes and bounded assertion failures. Credit costs one of three match credits with a 45-second cooldown. At least 30 seconds must remain; any subsequent edit clears current verification. Victory is checked at the round deadline.
